compiled_state.description:
## Goal
Write tests/scripts/test-classify-epic-class.sh before the script exists (RED). Tests cover all 4 classification categories.

## Test Cases
1. Epic with schema/migration keywords → class:architectural
2. Epic with external API/service keywords → class:integration
3. Epic with infrastructure/deploy keywords → class:infra
4. Epic with behavior/feature/skill keywords → class:behavioral
5. Epic with no recognizable keywords → class:behavioral (default)
6. Machine-readable output: JSON {class: 'class:architectural'} not prose

## Acceptance Criteria
- bash tests/scripts/test-classify-epic-class.sh exits non-zero (RED)
- chmod +x tests/scripts/test-classify-epic-class.sh
